captureMethod.focus: Pointer click into the first rendered text block, then Chrome keyboard Meta+A.
captureMethod.sourceSelection: After Meta+A, read window.getSelection().toString() as a separate observation; no script-created Range is assigned.
captureMethod.clipboard: Send Chrome keyboard Meta+C, observe the native copy event without preventing it, then read navigator.clipboard.read().
captureMethod.themeAndScale: Fresh context per viewport/theme/text-scale; colorScheme is the requested theme and the actual Markdown container font-size is scaled before copy.

normalization.sourceSelectionText: Exact JavaScript Selection.toString() UTF-16 string; encoded-byte count is UTF-8. Not a clipboard value.
normalization.textPlain: Exact Chrome text/plain clipboard string returned by Clipboard API; no trimming, Unicode normalization, newline conversion, or source reconstruction.
normalization.textHtml: Exact Chrome text/html clipboard string is stored once per source case (first selected configuration); every case/config records its SHA-256 and UTF-8 byte length.
normalization.hashes: SHA-256 is over the UTF-8 bytes of the exact text/html string returned by Clipboard API.

sourceCases.description: Ordinary inline math between prose fragments in one paragraph.
Inline math in a Markdown heading inherits heading font size, line height, and color.
An inline formula inside a raw HTML span remains rendered by the pinned Markdown math extension; capture its text flow and inherited styling.
Long inline expression with explicit KaTeX legal break opportunities; inspect the wrapped base spans at narrow width and 2x text scale.
